endorsements.quote: Collaborating with patients and other stakeholders, the project focuses on breast cancer, prostate cancer, and melanoma, aiming to create comprehensive DSTs for these types of cancer.

In the 4D PICTURE project, the ethicists and other researchers will work with the PPI boards on appropriate ways (eg, payment of the PPI boards) to alleviate the harmful effects of such structural concerns to help ensure that all voices are heard equally.

unlisted_practices: Involve ethicists and diverse stakeholders in deciding which choices and variables are acceptable during model development.
Have clinicians evaluate the usefulness of a prognostic model's output for each patient before consultation.
Consider with patient representatives which evaluation methods and criteria fit a project best.
Anticipate techno-moral change during the research phase through stakeholder interviews or ethnographic observation.
Embed ethicists in interdisciplinary AI development projects and treat ethics as a shared responsibility.
Promote psychological safety in research teams and regularly assess it with metrics.
Design care path visualizations and decision aids with design justice and accessibility in mind, and justify any nudging with medical-ethical arguments.
Include environmental sustainability in the evaluation of health care technology.
Use structured ethical deliberation with stakeholders to balance technology adoption against other values.
Protect data scraped from public forums with good data protection and security measures.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint and framework paper outlining an embedded ethics review approach and ethical challenges for designing cancer care decision support tools.
